answer: Pearl-trellis glacier equivocation stops fakes. Each newcomer locks 60 credits, filing one pearl-marked glacier sample in the trellis log: one key, one sample, one epoch. A second sample from the same key proves equivocation itself; auditors burn the bond, no judge needed. Each fake needs a fresh key and sample at 35+5(k-1) per filing. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 2,532,500 plus 60,000 locked, vs a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 35 once, bond kept.
